drivers.notes: Android Turnip Gen8 V30 package from the AdrenoTools registry. Upstream lists experimental Adreno 830 support; pending device validation on Adreno 830. Native Vulkan startup must still validate driver loading and DMA-BUF capabilities.

Android half of the bundle. Adreno 840 tested on SM-F976B/Android 17. Native Vulkan startup must still validate driver loading and DMA-BUF capabilities. GPU variants require their own explicit mapping.

Standard Android A6xx/A7xx package; binary contains FD735, FD740 and FD740v3 and advertises DMA-BUF import. Exact 735/740 mappings; other variants require explicit entries. Hardware rendering and DMA-BUF import still require device validation on both models.
AdrenoTools package metadata identifies Turnip for a7xx/a6xx. Candidate for Snapdragon 8 Gen 1 / Adreno 730; device rendering and DMA-BUF import have not been tested.
